title: Catalog snapshot tiles + deprecation badge variants for release notes and onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and produce a comprehensive set of catalog and pricing screenshots to ship with the upcoming March release notes and onboarding quickstarts. Deliverables include hero catalog tiles for two new model families, retired/deprecated state tiles and badges, compact pricing badges for in-console tooltips, dark/light theme variants, responsive crops for doc and in-app placement (desktop/tablet/mobile), and annotated source art for engineering handoff. These assets will be used in: release notes, quickstart guides, console model cards, and marketing one-pagers. Ensure accessibility contrast and text legibility across compressed PNG/JPEG exports.

2026-03-02 Accessibility review (internal): Contrast ratios checked, increased font weight for price numbers at 12px to meet AA. Confirmed with accessibility label specs.
2026-03-04 Engineering feedback (ENG-20212): Need separate 2x exported assets for the mobile web renderer; also prefer SVG for badges. Marked follow-up in dependencies.
2026-03-07 A/B test proposal: PM suggests running two CTA treatments in release notes — 'Try in Console' vs 'See Pricing' — capture variant screenshots for both.
2026-03-09 Marco Liu: Finalized dark/light exports and responsive crops. Pushed master exports to Drive. Noted remaining task: update in-console tooltip copy to match badge microcopy.
2026-03-10 Aisha Patel: Ready for QA handoff. Added metadata keys to export filenames per asset naming convention.
notes: Important decisions: use 'Deprecated' red pill + strike overlay for legacy models; use a muted gray 'Sunset' state for retired model tiles in docs only (not in-console). Use numeric pricing emphasis (e.g., $0.002/token) with small caps descriptor. Exports must include 1x, 2x PNG and SVG badges. QA checklist: visual parity across themes, no truncation of model names at common container widths, validate all URLs embedded in release notes screenshots.
